title: GL Account Master
description: The list of account numbers (like 231 New Cars, 263 Warranty Claims) that everything in the store eventually posts to.
x-api-note: GL account master schema (account number format, type codes, cost-center segmentation) is not publicly documented at field level anywhere in CDK/Fortellis material; only workflow-level marketing language and a third-party audit tool's export path confirm the object exists.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

base_account_number_3_digit.description: 3-digit number identifying the natural account, e.g. 231 = New Cars inventory

department_suffix_2_digit.description: A 2-digit code appended after a hyphen, e.g. 013-01 = Delivery Expense, New Vehicle Dept

sub_account_letter_suffix.description: A letter suffix splits an account further, e.g. 446A Used Cars Retail-Certified vs 446B Used Cars Retail-Other

reporting_account_factory_statement_mapp.description: A many-to-one mapping from your internal GL account to the manufacturer's own statement line number, confirmed on a comparable DMS's GL setup screen
reporting_account_factory_statement_mapp.x-source-title: Dominion DMS help — Create a new sales general ledger account

company_number_grouping_dimension.description: A third-party audit tool confirms exporting CDK's GL by 'company number', proving this dimension exists above the account number for multi-rooftop groups
company_number_grouping_dimension.x-source-title: MindBridge — CDK ERP: Export the general ledger

account_mapping_inventory_to_gl_interfac.description: An 'Account Mapping' function interfaces vehicle inventory setup screens to the Accounting subsystem to retrieve GL codes, journals, and chart of accounts
account_mapping_inventory_to_gl_interfac.x-source-title: Lithia connectCDK — Vehicle Inventory Setups, Account Mapping
